text:
ashley: quick flag — during a cross-region traffic spike proxies with local caches cumulatively exceeded tenant quota. suspect local-cache TTL + parallel proxies is the root cause.

dmitri: reproduced in staging. each proxy used its cache pocket and we ended up double-counting for short windows.

kevin: TTL was meant to cut round-trip p99. we need a middle ground: small per-proxy reserve granted by central that acts like a pocket of tokens. refill is best-effort.

maria: sketch: central quota-service hands out tiny reservoirs with lease TTL. proxies spend locally until reservoir drains, then fall back to sync checks. central is still source-of-truth for billing.

lee: emergency rules: if central detects aggregate(local_spent) - central_spent > 10% for 1s, it issues a fast-decline (grant=0) and proxies must stop using reservoirs immediately.

kevin: proto example:

POST /quota/v1/reserve
{
  "tenant_id": "t123",
  "proxy_id": "px-9",
  "request": 40,
  "idempotency_key": "abc-123"
}

=>
{
  "granted": 12,
  "lease_ms": 500
}

Proxies treat granted until lease_ms expires. retries use idempotency_key to avoid double grants.

maria: telemetry: reservoir_granted, reservoir_used, reservoir_delta (local - central). spike detector alerts when delta crosses threshold. dashboard + alerts first before rollout.

dmitri: security checklist: mTLS, proxy identity, idempotency token, per-proxy rate limits for reserve API, persist ledger entries for reconciliation.

lee: rollout plan: 1) shadow mode (proxies report what they'd admit) 2) enable tiny reservoirs (5-20 tokens) for canary tenants 3) watch telemetry and alarms 4) widen. include rollback playbook that flips proxies to central-only.

ashley: action items: kevin -> RFC + proto (4d); maria -> telemetry queries & dashboard (5d); lee -> rollout/runbook (3d); dmitri -> security checklist (3d).

kevin: starting RFC draft in gh now. ping me for pairing.

maria: will add spike alerts to prometheus and a grafana panel.

lee: coordinating canary window with infra ops.

ashley: thanks all — i'll combine into a short RFC follow-up once kevin's proto is up. objections? :thumbsup:
